headline: Wall Street Sinks as AI Infrastructure Stocks Plunge After US Midterms
summary: U.S. stocks suffered a severe sell-off, with the S&P 500 falling 4.4% and the Nasdaq plunging over 5%, driven by investor fears that a Democratic victory in the U.S. midterms could lead to stricter regulations and curb artificial intelligence infrastructure spending.
why: The technology sector and AI-related infrastructure have been primary drivers of market gains, making valuations sensitive to regulatory shifts or changes in government policy following political elections.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The S&P 500 dropped 4.4% in a broad market sell-off triggered by concerns over potential AI infrastructure policy changes.
